title: Hut-hzf/ung220z-tool
why_read: A niche credential-extraction tool for a specific Chinese ISP's router model, useful only to a narrow audience and raising some legitimacy concerns around its intended use.
analysis: This tool extracts admin credentials from a specific router/ONT model (UNG220Z) used by China Mobile, intended according to its description for recovering forgotten passwords or migrating configurations on one's own device. This is a fairly narrow piece of hardware reverse-engineering work relevant mainly to users of that specific hardware in China. While the stated purpose is legitimate self-service recovery, credential-extraction tools for networking gear always carry dual-use risk if applied to devices the user doesn't own. It's a niche but not clearly malicious utility.
